newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-SABRES BEAT COYOTES 5-1.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-SABRES BEAT COYOTES 5-1.

text.p: Derek Plante scored his 19th and 20th goals and set up another and Dominik Hasek made 30 saves to lead the surging Buffalo Sabres to a 5-1 victory over the Phoenix Coyotes on Sunday.
Jason Dawe, Michael Grosek and Richard Smehlik also tallied for Buffalo, which is 7-1-2 in its last 10 games.
Dawe put the Sabres ahead for good, 1-0, when he ended a seven-game goal drought at 5:11 of the first period.
"I don't know what it is," Plante said. "The puck's going in here, I'm getting some bounces, some great passes. Hopefully, I can take it on the road."
At New Jersey, former Devils Ricard Persson and Scott Pellerin scored to cap a three-goal second period that rallied the St. Louis Blues to a 5-3 victory over New Jersey.
Scott Stevens and Jay Pandolfo scored in the first period for the Devils.
Grant Fuhr made 30 saves for the Blues, who are 2-0-2 in their last four.
In Chicago, Gary Suter scored with 2:12 left in the third period to snap a 25-game goal-less drought and lift the Chicago Blackhawks into a 5-5 tie with Detroit Red Wings.
Suter took a pass from Chris Chelios between the points and skated to his left before lifting a high wrist shot through traffic and over goaltender Mike Vernon's left shoulder.
Chelios had a goal and an assist and Cam Russell, Eric Daze and Jim Cummins also scored for the Blackhawks.
